name: every global setting
global:
{
  "lastChangelogVersion": "0.5.0",
  "defaultProvider": "anthropic",
  "defaultModel": "claude-test",
  "defaultThinkingLevel": "medium",
  "modelThinkingLevels": {
    "anthropic/claude-test": "high",
    "openai/gpt": "low"
  },
  "transport": "websocket",
  "steeringMode": "all",
  "followUpMode": "all",
  "theme": "dark",
  "compaction": {
    "enabled": false,
    "reserveTokens": 1000,
    "keepRecentTokens": 2000
  },
  "harnessCore": {
    "alignment": false,
    "verifyCommands": [
      "npm test",
      5,
      "cargo test"
    ],
    "maxChangedLines": 0
  },
  "branchSummary": {
    "reserveTokens": 100,
    "skipPrompt": true
  },
  "retry": {
    "enabled": false,
    "maxRetries": 7,
    "baseDelayMs": 10,
    "maxAgentDelayMs": 20,
    "provider": {
      "timeoutMs": 5,
      "maxRetries": 2
    }
  },
  "hideThinkingBlock": true,
  "showCacheMissNotices": true,
  "externalEditor": "code --wait",
  "shellPath": "~/bin/bash",
  "quietStartup": "header",
  "defaultProjectTrust": "always",
  "shellCommandPrefix": "shopt -s expand_aliases",
  "npmCommand": [
    "mise",
    "exec",
    "--",
    "npm"
  ],
  "collapseChangelog": true,
  "enableInstallTelemetry": false,
  "enableAnalytics": true,
  "trackingId": "tracking",
  "packages": [
    "npm:a",
    {
      "source": "git:b",
      "autoload": false,
      "skills": [
        "x"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "extensions": [
    "ext.ts"
  ],
  "skills": [
    "skills"
  ],
  "prompts": [
    "prompts"
  ],
  "themes": [
    "themes"
  ],
  "enableSkillCommands": false,
  "terminal": {
    "showImages": false,
    "imageWidthCells": 42.7,
    "clearOnShrink": true,
    "showTerminalProgress": true,
    "images": false,
    "trueColor": true,
    "hyperlinks": false
  },
  "images": {
    "autoResize": false,
    "blockImages": true
  },
  "enabledModels": [
    "anthropic/*"
  ],
  "defaultTools": [
    "read",
    "grep"
  ],
  "doubleEscapeAction": "fork",
  "treeFilterMode": "user-only",
  "thinkingBudgets": {
    "low": 1000
  },
  "editorPaddingX": 2,
  "outputPad": 0,
  "autocompleteMaxVisible": 9,
  "showHardwareCursor": true,
  "markdown": {
    "codeBlockIndent": "    ",
    "mermaid": "off"
  },
  "warnings": {
    "anthropicExtraUsage": false
  },
  "sessionDir": "~/sessions",
  "httpIdleTimeoutMs": 1500.7,
  "cacheWarming": "idle",
  "websocketConnectTimeoutMs": "disabled",
  "tuiMode": "regular",
  "fullscreenExitOutput": "resume-hint",
  "fullscreenScrollbar": "hidden",
  "fullscreenCopyOnSelect": false,
  "fullscreenWheelScrollLines": 400,
  "unknownField": {
    "kept": true
  }
}
